conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: I have a severe headache, worse than my usual migraines, and I'm worried about my blood pressure

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: This morning, suddenly, like nothing I've had before

conversation.speaker: assistant
conversation.text: Do you have any neck stiffness, sensitivity to light, or any weakness anywhere?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: No neck stiffness but the light is bothering me

conversation.speaker: assistant
conversation.text: Do you have any nausea or vomiting?

conversation.speaker: assistant
conversation.text: When was your last blood pressure check and what was it?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: I don't remember exactly, but my doctor said it was controlled

conversation.speaker: assistant
conversation.text: This needs nurse review. Your symptoms could be several things - severe migraine, high blood pressure, or something else. A nurse will help determine if you need urgent evaluation.

sbar_structure.situation: 48-year-old female with sudden-onset severe headache described as worse than usual migraines, photophobia, and nausea
sbar_structure.background: 48-year-old female with history of migraines, diabetes, hypertension; takes medications with possibly controlled blood pressure
sbar_structure.assessment: Sudden severe headache with photophobia; differential includes severe migraine versus hypertensive emergency versus meningitis; requires evaluation to rule out dangerous causes
sbar_structure.recommendation: Nurse or urgent care evaluation; consider blood pressure check; if any red flag features develop (neck stiffness, neurological symptoms), go to ER; consider imaging if not typical migraine presentation
